rendered:
In Fig. 2[1], nanocarriers used to deliver siRNA against tumor metastasis are sorted under these headings:[2]

- **Lipid-based nanoparticles:** Liposome and LNP.[3]
- **EVs-based nanoparticles:** EVs and Exosome.[4]
- **Polymeric-based nanoparticles:** Polymer, Dendrimer, Polymer micelle and Tri-Block Copolymer.[5]
- **Metal-based nanoparticles:** AuNPs, SPIONs and MOF.[6]
- **Other nanoparticles:** CQD, MSNP and Chitosan.[7]

The caption adds that these nanocarriers can reach tumors passively through the EPR effect.[8]

source.caption: Fig. 2. Various nanocarriers are used to deliver siRNA for targeting tumor metastasis. Created in BioRender. Fu, Y. (2026) https://BioRender.com/kusjibi These nanocarriers can achieve passive targeting through the EPR effect.
